plainTranslation: Mind meets drive. The Mercury person's thinking gets energized and quickened; the Mars person sharpens it into action. Stimulating, decisive, fast. At worst, conversations turn into arguments and words turn into weapons. Failure mode: bickering and cutting remarks. Aim the mental heat at problems, not at each other.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
note: Synced from authored synastry bundle synastry-authored__19_ (2).json.
summaryDeep: Their questions, explanations, and way of talking sit right on top of your drive, timing, and willingness to act. This is one of the closest contacts between you, strong and constant, energizing at its best and a lot to hold at its worst. Let the closeness feed you without letting it run you.
tension: The challenge is learning when to slow the conversation down. Both of you may be quick to respond, quick to react, or quick to move to the next point before fully taking in what was said. At times, this can create unnecessary tension or make a simple difference of opinion feel bigger than it is.
advice: This aspect works better when both people track how and when things are said.
